report_name: Staffing Firm HumanEdge Discloses Breach Exposing SSNs

threat_actors.name: Unnamed Attacker in HumanEdge Breach
threat_actors.description: An unidentified threat actor who compromised the network of the staffing firm HumanEdge, Inc., accessing and exfiltrating files containing sensitive personal information, including Social Security numbers.
threat_actors.goals: Data theft for identity theft and financial crime.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Local System
attack_patterns.description: The unauthorized actor accessed files on the HumanEdge network containing sensitive Personally Identifiable Information (PII) of employees, job applicants, and clients.

attack_patterns.name: Data Staged
attack_patterns.description: The threat actor likely aggregated sensitive files containing PII, possibly compressing them into archives (e.g., .zip, .rar) before exfiltration, as suggested by hunting hints for this type of incident.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over Web Service
attack_patterns.description: The threat actor likely exfiltrated staged data using legitimate cloud sync tools like rclone.exe or megasync.exe to transfer data to attacker-controlled cloud storage, blending in with normal traffic.

tools.name: rclone
tools.description: The use of rclone was suggested as a hunting hint for detecting data exfiltration. Attackers use this legitimate cloud sync tool to transfer stolen data to their own cloud storage accounts.

tools.name: MegaSync
tools.description: The use of MegaSync was suggested as a hunting hint for detecting data exfiltration. Attackers use this legitimate cloud sync tool to transfer stolen data to their own cloud storage accounts.

identities.name: HumanEdge, Inc.
identities.description: A New York-based national staffing and recruitment firm that suffered a data breach exposing sensitive personal information of employees, job applicants, and clients.

indicators.name: Suspicious Archive File Creation For Data Staging
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Archive File Creation For Data Staging
id: 2b9c1a8e-5d7f-4b1a-9c8d-6f3e2a1b0c9d
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of large archive files which could indicate data being staged for exfiltration, a common tactic in data breaches targeting PII.
references:
  - https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/09/06/3356898/0/en/humanedge-inc-data-breach-edelson-lechtzin-llp-launches-investigation-into-exposure-of-social-security-numbers.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-06
modified: 2026-09-06
tags:
  - attack.t1074
  - attack.collection
level: medium
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '.zip'
      - '.rar'
      - '.7z'
  filter_legit_paths:
    TargetFilename|startswith:
      - 'C:\Program Files\'
      - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\'
      - 'C:\Windows\'
  condition: selection and not filter_legit_paths
indicators.description: Detects the creation of archive files (zip, rar, 7z), which could be an attacker staging sensitive data for exfiltration. This was suggested as a hunting hint for breaches of this type.

indicators.name: Cloud Sync Tool Execution For Data Exfiltration
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Cloud Sync Tool Execution For Data Exfiltration
id: 8c1d9b2a-7e6f-4a0b-8d5c-3f2e1a0b9c8d
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of legitimate cloud sync tools like rclone.exe or megasync.exe, which are often abused by attackers to exfiltrate data.
references:
  - https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/09/06/3356898/0/en/humanedge-inc-data-breach-edelson-lechtzin-llp-launches-investigation-into-exposure-of-social-security-numbers.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-06
modified: 2026-09-06
tags:
  - attack.t1567
  - attack.exfiltration
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\rclone.exe'
      - '\megasync.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of legitimate cloud synchronization tools (rclone, MegaSync) that are commonly abused by attackers to exfiltrate stolen data to their own cloud storage accounts.
